text.L1: A point marks an exact position. It has no size.
text.L2: A line segment has two endpoints and a fixed length you can measure.
text.L3: A line has no endpoints and continues forever in both directions.
text.L4: Drawing it longer on paper does not make a different line; paper shows only part.
text.L5: A ray has one endpoint and continues forever in one direction.
text.L6: Ray AB starts at A and passes through B, so ray BA points the other way.
text.L7: In our example, both rays start at O: ray OA and ray OB. They point in opposite directions, so they are different rays.
text.L8: Which figure has one endpoint and continues in one direction? Tap it.
